description: Use when the user asks whether any company, or which of a named set of competitors, now reports a figure (a franchise share, ARPU, a retention rate, a concentration, a multiple), or whether a public comparable discloses the metric a deal model depends on. Returns, from SEC EDGAR full-text search, which filers use the phrase in their filings over the years given, with the first and latest filing linked; for named peers, who does, who does not, and who could not be measured because they filed nothing. Every result carries a run id, a date and a citation line. Calling this tool returns a quote, not the result: what the run measures, its price and a payment_url. The run happens only when you POST to payment_url, and a run that fails its controls refuses there with nothing charged. Price: $0.05 per run over x402 (USDC on Base, no account needed), or $0.50 over MPP (a Stripe shared payment token); charged only when the run comes back sound. For the share of all 10-K filers over time, use run_filing_trend. A real sample of this run, free: https://cultmath.com/agent/samples/disclosure-check.json

end.description: Last year. At most 10 years per run.

peers.description: Optional: 2-10 tickers, comma-separated, from: PEP, KO, K, POST, KDP, CELH, UTZ, HRL, GIS, KHC, CAG, CPB, HSY, MDLZ, SJM, CLX, CL, CHD, PG, SMPL, BRBR, MSFT, EA, TTWO, RBLX, OMC, STGW, CRM, HUBS, TDOC, TALK, GDDY, GEN, NFLX, AMZN. Omit to search all filers.

phrase.description: The phrase to measure, without quote marks.

start.description: First year. Default: two years ago.
